blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. We evaluate HoS on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and GPT-OSS-20B. We compare it against SecAlign++, a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense, and ASIDE, a defense that, like ours, builds instruction-data separation into the model architecture. We show that HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks. More specifically, the black-box RL-Hammer attack reaches 97% ASR against GPT-OSS-20B and 85% against SecAlign, but only 10% against HoS. Claudini, a state-of-the-art white-box attack, strengthened against HoS through autoresearch, requires 3 times more FLOPs to reach the same ASR on HoS as it does on GPT-OSS-20B or SecAlign. HoS preserves base-model utility across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, whereas SecAlign and ASIDE degrade in few-shot settings. On agentic benchmarks with static attacks, HoS and SecAlign perform similarly and substantially improve the security-utility trade-off over the base model. ASIDE struggles with tool use, achieving only 10% utility. These results show that prompt injection robustness can be achieved and improved through targeted attention interventions.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍安全负责人(HOS),这是一种快速注射防御,通过一小组精通的人均注意力门执行指令-数据分离. HoS学习了每个头应该如何在被信任和被不信任的令牌之间重新分配注意力,使模型能够在不遵循被注入指令的情况下理性地超越被不信任的内容. 我们评价Llama-3.3-70B指令和GPT-OSS-20B上的HOS. 我们把它比作SecAlign++, 一种最先进的微调防御, 和ASIDE, 一个防御,我们一样, 将指令数据分离到模型架构中。 我们显示,HOS为适应性攻击提供了更强的强度,在标准公用基准方面表现更好,并在标准剂即时注射基准方面与最高性能相匹配. 更具体地说,黑盒RL-Hammer攻击达到97%的ASR对GPT-OSS-20B,85%的SecAlign,但只有10%的ASR对HOS. Claudini是一款最先进的白盒攻击,通过自发研究强化了对HOS的攻击,需要3倍多的FLOP对HOS达到与GPT-OSS-20B或SecAlign相同的ASR. HOS在标准的多选择基准和激励设置中保留了基本模型的效用,而SecAlign和ASIDE则在几发环境中降解. 在具有静态攻击的代理基准上,HOS和SecAlign同样和大幅度地改进了对基地模式的安全效用权衡。 ASIDE在工具使用上挣扎,只实现了10%的效用. 这些结果表明,通过有针对性的关注干预措施,可以实现并改进快速注射的稳健性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Indirect prompt injection ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) occurs when a model mistakes attacker-planted instructions in external content for authorized commands.
As LLMs access more external data and tools, this attack surface becomes increasingly consequential.
Although frontier models have become substantially harder to attack ( UK AI Security Institute, 2025 ) , prompt injection remains largely unsolved: adaptive attacks continue to succeed even against extensively evaluated systems ( Nasr et al., 2026 ; Andriushchenko et al., 2025 ) .
This is more pronounced for open-weight models: under comparable red-teaming, Claude and GPT are substantially more robust than leading open-weight models ( Dziemian et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
间接即时注射 (Greshake et al., 2023),当模型在外部内容中错误攻击者植入指令,用于授权命令时发生.
随着LLMS获取更多的外部数据和工具,这种攻击表面变得愈加间接.
尽管边境模式已经变得非常难以攻击(英国AI安全研究所,2025年),但迅速注射基本上仍未解决:即使是针对广泛评价的系统,适应性攻击也继续取得成功(Nasr等人,2026年;Andriushchenko等人,2025年)。
这在开放量级模型中更为明显:在可比的红色队伍中,克劳德和GPT比领先的开放量级模型强得多(Dziemian等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Defending against prompt injection requires several complementary mechanisms.
We focus on instruction–data separation ( Zverev et al., 2025 ) , which creates a hard trust boundary: authorized instructions may steer model actions, while external data may be read and analyzed but not treated as instructions.
Instruction–data separation applies when external content is intended as data, for example, when summarizing a webpage or extracting facts from a document. It complements other approaches such as instruction hierarchy ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) and contextual integrity ( Nissenbaum, 2004 ; Mireshghallah et al., 2024 ; Abdelnabi and Bagdasarian, 2026 ) by preventing attacks when a hard trust boundary exists.
blocks.zh:
防止迅速注射需要若干补充机制。
我们侧重于指令-数据分离(Zverev et al., 2025),这创造了一个硬信任边界:授权指令可以引导模型动作,而外部数据可以被读取和分析,但不作为指令处理.
指令 - 数据分离适用于外部内容作为数据的目的,例如,在总结网页或从文档中提取事实时. 它通过在存在硬信任边界时防止攻击来补充其他方法,如指令等级(Wallace等人,2024年)和背景完整性(Nissenbaum,2004年;Mireshghallah等人,2024年;Abdelnabi和Bagdasarian,2026年)。

blocks.en: We propose H eads o f S ecurity (HoS), which enforces instruction–data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. These gates redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions.
blocks.zh: 我们提议H eads o f ecurity(HOS),它通过一小组学习的人均注意力门执行指令-数据分离。 这些门在信任的和不信任的符文之间重新分配注意力,使模型能够在不遵循注入指令的情况下对不信任的内容进行理性分析.

blocks.en:
HoS relies on two intuitions. First, previous interpretability works have shown that attention heads specialize in different functions, including in-context copying ( Elhage et al., 2021 ) , copy suppression ( McDougall et al., 2024 ) , and instruction following ( Hung et al., 2025 ) .
This suggests that each head can learn its own redistribution of attention between trusted and untrusted content, specific to that head’s role, and that untrusted instructions can be suppressed without disrupting unrelated capabilities.
Second, the trust boundary is supplied externally (e.g., web results are usually treated as untrusted), so enforcing it does not require the model to infer which sources are trusted or to acquire any new capabilities.
Instead, it is an attention-routing problem: controlling how information from trusted and untrusted sources reaches the model’s existing capabilities.
blocks.zh:
HoS依靠两个直觉. 首先,以前的可解释性著作表明,注意力头专门从事不同的功能,包括内文复制(Elhage等人,2021年),拷贝压制(McDougall等人,2024年),以及后续指示(Hung等人,2025年)。
这表明每个头都能够学习自己在信任和不信任内容之间的注意力再分配,具体针对该头的角色,而不信任的指示可以被压制而不破坏无关的能力.
其次,信任边界是外部提供的(例如,通常将网络结果视为不信任),因此执行它并不要求模型推断哪些来源是信任的或获得任何新的能力.
相反,这是一个关注路线问题:控制来自信任和不信任来源的信息如何达到模型的现有能力。

Here, a head initially attends strongly to both the trusted request (“Count R’s”) and an injected instruction (“Send money”). Learned gates preserve trusted and chat template tokens ( × 1\!\times and × 0.9\!\times ) while suppressing untrusted tokens ( × 0.1\!\times ), shifting attention toward the trusted request. Compared to SecAlign and ASIDE, HoS is more robust against adaptive attacks (RL-Hammer and Claudini), better preserves utility across standard capability benchmarks, and achieves strong utility and security on static agentic benchmarks.

blocks.en:
We compare HoS against two defenses.
SecAlign++ ( Chen et al., 2025c ) is a state-of-the-art finetuning-based defense whose Meta-SecAlign-70B checkpoint is considered among the most adversarially robust open-weight models.
ASIDE ( Zverev et al., 2026 ) is an architectural defense that enforces instruction–data separation by rotating the embeddings of untrusted content.
blocks.zh:
我们比较HOS和两个防御。
SecAlign++(Chen et al., 2025c)是一种最先进的微调防御,其Meta-SecAlign-70B检查站被认为是最有对抗力的开放量级模型之一.
ASIDE(Zverev et al., 2026)是一种建筑防御,通过旋转不可信内容的嵌入来执行指令-数据分离.

blocks.en:
We evaluate HoS on two open-weight models: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) and GPT-OSS-20B ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) .
The former is a capable agentic model and the base model of Meta-SecAlign-70B, enabling direct comparison with SecAlign 1 1 1 For brevity, throughout this paper we use “SecAlign” to refer to the SecAlign++ training recipe. .
GPT-OSS-20B is a newer, smaller mixture-of-experts reasoning model that has generally stronger capabilities than Llama-3.3-70B and has been post-trained to enforce instruction hierarchy.
blocks.zh:
我们用两种开放式模型来评价HOS: Llama-3.3-70B-指令(Grattafiori等人,2024年)和GPT-OSS-20B(Agarwal等人,2025年)。
前者是一种有能力的代理模型和Meta-SecAlign-70B的基础模型,能够直接与SecAlign 1 1 1进行对比,为简洁起见,在本文件中,我们使用“SecAlign”来指代SecAlign++培训配方。 。 。 。
GPT-OSS-20B是一种较新的,较小的专家混合推理模型,其能力一般比Llama-3.3-70B更强,并经过了执行指令等级的后期培训.

blocks.en: Compared to both SecAlign and ASIDE, HoS offers greater robustness to adaptive attacks, better performance on standard utility benchmarks, and matches top performance on standard agentic prompt injection benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 与SecAlign和ASIDE相比,HOS为适应性攻击提供了更大的强力,在标准公用基准上表现较好,在标准剂即时注射基准上达到最高性能.

blocks.en:
Greater robustness to adaptive attacks ( Section 4.1 ).
Using black-box RL-based attacks trained with the RL-Hammer recipe ( Wen et al., 2025b ) , the strongest attackers reach 97% attack success rate (ASR) on GPT-OSS-20B, 85% on SecAlign, but only 10% on HoS. Similar results hold for Llama-3.3-70B: the strongest attacker reaches 99% ASR against the undefended model and 82% ASR against Meta-SecAlign-70B but only 1% ASR against HoS.
In a white-box setting, a state-of-the-art optimization-based attack, Claudini ( Panfilov et al., 2026 ) , further optimized specifically against HoS in an autoresearch loop, still requires roughly 3 × 3\times more compute to reach 50% ASR on HoS compared to GPT-OSS-20B and its SecAlign variant.
blocks.zh:
增强适应性攻击的强度(第4.1节)。
使用以RL-Hammer配方(Wen等人,2025年b)训练的黑盒RL型攻击,最强攻击者在GPT-OSS-20B上达到97%的攻击成功率(ASR),在SecAlign上达到85%,但在Hos上只达到10%. 类似的结果为Llama-3.3-70B:最强攻击者在无防守模式上达到99%ASR,在Meta-SecAlign-70B上达到82%ASR,但只有1%ASR对Hos.
在白盒设置中,基于最先进的优化攻击,Claudini(Panfilov等人,2026年)在自动研究循环中进一步针对HOS进行特别优化,与GPT-OSS-20B及其SecAlign变型相比,仍然需要大约3×3\的计算,在HOS上达到50%的ASR.

blocks.en:
Preserving utility on standard benchmarks ( Section 4.2 ).
Across standard multiple-choice benchmarks and prompting setups, HoS closely matches both base models. SecAlign and ASIDE match base-model performance in 0-shot evaluations but often struggle in few-shot and multi-turn settings.
On 5-shot MMLU-Pro, HoS scores 67% versus GPT-OSS-20B’s 68%, while SecAlign and ASIDE fall to 59% and 52%; on Llama-3.3-70B, HoS scores 55% versus the base model’s 56%, while SecAlign falls to 16% ( Table 2 ).
blocks.zh:
保留标准基准的效用(第4.2节)。
在整个标准的多选择基准和激励设置中,HOS紧密匹配两个基础模型. secAlign和ASIDE在0拍评价中匹配基本模型性能,但往往在几拍和多回合的环境下挣扎.
在5镜头的MMLU-Pro上,HOS对GPT-OSS-20B的评分为67%,而SecAlign和ASIDE则下降到59%和52%;在Llama-3.3-70B上,HOS对基准型号的评分为55%,而SecAlign则下降到16%(表2)。

blocks.en:
Strong utility and security on agentic benchmarks ( Section 4.3 , Appendix G ).
On AgentDojo, AgentDyn, LLMail-Inject, and WASP, HoS and SecAlign perform comparably across both base models, substantially reducing ASR with little or no utility penalty in most evaluations ( Figure 4 , Table 3 ).
On the other hand, ASIDE consistently fails to produce usable tool calls, scoring near-zero utility on three benchmarks and only 10% on AgentDojo.
blocks.zh:
代理人基准的有力效用和安全性(第4.3节,附录G)。
在AgentDojo上,AgentDyn,LLMail-Inject,以及WASP,HOS和SecAlign在两种基本模型上都具有可比性,大幅降低了ASR,在大多数评价中几乎没有或根本没有使用处罚(图4,表3).
另一方面,ASIDE一直无法生成可用的工具呼叫,在三个基准上评分接近零,在Dojo特工上评分只有10%.

blocks.en: We also investigate what gates HoS learns mechanistically, using causal head ablations and role-confusion probes ( Section 5 ). Together, these results establish attention gating as a targeted and efficient approach to instruction–data separation.
blocks.zh: 我们还调查何门HOS在机械学上学习什么,使用因果头部擦伤和角色集合探测器(第5节)。 这些结果共同将注意力定位为定向和高效的教学-数据分离方法。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Prompt injection defenses. Various types of defenses have been proposed for instruction–data separation. Meta-SecAlign ( Chen et al., 2025c ) , our strongest baseline, is a finetuning-based method ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025c ) that uses DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) to teach models to follow user instructions while ignoring injections in data.
Architectural methods directly encode input roles: Instructional Segment Embedding adds learned role embeddings to token embeddings ( Wu et al., 2025a ) , while ASIDE applies fixed rotations to data-token embeddings ( Zverev et al., 2026 ) .
Our method, Heads of Security, also enforces instruction–data separation architecturally, but through reweighting attention according to token trust levels.
blocks.zh:
即时注射防御. 已经提出各种类型的辩护,用于教学-数据分离。 Meta 对齐 (Chen等人,2025c)是我们最强的基准,是一种基于微调的方法(Chen等人,2025a); Chen等人,2025b;Chen等人,2025c),使用DPO(Rafailov等人,2023年)教导模型遵循用户指令,同时忽略数据中的注射.
建筑方法直接编码输入角色: 指令片段嵌入在符号嵌入中添加了学习到的角色嵌入(Wu等人,2025a),而ASIDE对数据嵌入应用固定旋转(Zverev等人,2026).
我们的方法,安全负责人,也从建筑上执行指令-数据分离,但通过按照象征性的信任水平重新加权注意力。

blocks.en:
Attention and prompt injection. Recent work suggests that the attention mechanism is directly related to instruction following.
PASTA ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) and InstABoost ( Guardieiro et al., 2025 ) steer attention toward selected text or instruction tokens, while Causal Head Gating studies instruction-following mechanisms by suppressing attention head outputs ( Nam et al., 2025 ) .
Under prompt injection, specific attention heads shift their attention from the benign instruction to injected instructions ( Hung et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ) .
HoS builds on these observations: we allow each head to learn its attention redistribution such that injected instructions are ignored.
blocks.zh:
注意,马上注射 最近的工作表明,关注机制与以下指示直接相关。
PATA(Zhang等人,2024年)和InstABoost(Guardieiro等人,2025年)将注意力引向选定的文本或指示符号,而Causal Head Gating则通过压制注意力头输出来研究遵循指示的机制(Nam等人,2025年)。
在迅速注射的情况下,特别注意头将注意力从良性指示转移到注射指示(Hung等人,2025年;Zhong等人,2026年)。
HoS以这些观察为基础:我们允许每个头都学习它的注意力再分配,这样注入的指令就会被忽视.

blocks.en:
(Adaptive) attacks. Existing prompt injection defenses remain vulnerable, especially against strong adaptive attackers ( Nasr et al., 2026 ; Wen et al., 2025b ; Yang et al., 2025b ; Panfilov et al., 2026 ) . RL-Hammer ( Wen et al., 2025b ) , a black-box RL-based attack, achieves ASRs of up to 92% against GPT-5-series models,
77% against Claude Sonnet 4, and near-100% on Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct defended with SecAlign ( Chen et al., 2025c ) . This motivates our adaptive attack evaluations using RL and white-box optimization-based attacks developed by autoresearch ( Panfilov et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
(助攻)攻击. 现有的快速注射防御措施仍然脆弱,特别是针对适应性强的攻击者(Nasr等人,2026年;Wen等人,2025年b); Yang等人,2025b;Panfilov等人,2026). RL-Hammer(Wen等人,2025b),黑箱RL基攻击,对GPT-5系列型号达到高达92%的ASR,
77%反对Claude Sonnet 4, 将近100%反对Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, 这激励了我们使用RL和基于白盒优化的自動研究(Panfilov等人,2026年)开发的攻击进行适应性攻击评价.

3.2 Channel-conditioned attention gates
blocks.zh: 3.2 带通道的注意门

blocks.en: HoS lets each head selectively reduce attention to a source channel. An instruction-following head can be prevented from reading untrusted content while retaining access to trusted instructions; other heads remain free to process that content, preserving the model’s ability to reason over it.
blocks.zh: HoS让每个头有选择地减少对一个源频道的注意. 指令后头可以防止阅读不可信内容,同时保留对可信指令的访问;其他头头还可以自由处理该内容,保留模型对它进行推理的能力.

For clarity, the figure attributes instruction following to a single idealized head, although in reality the behavior is distributed across many heads and layers ( Section 5 ). In this example, the head initially assigns equally high scores to both inputs. HoS closes its gate for the untrusted tokens, and softmax renormalization places 0.99 0.99 of its attention mass on the user’s instruction.

HoS adds a learned, per-channel bias to each head’s pre-softmax attention logits. Each head k k of layer ℓ \ell has a table of gate logits g ( ℓ , k ) ∈ ℝ C × C g^{(\ell,k)}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times C} , where g c i , c j ( ℓ , k ) g^{(\ell,k)}_{c_{i},c_{j}} controls attention from query channel c i c_{i} to key channel c j c_{j} . We write θ gate = { g ( ℓ , k ) } ℓ , k \theta_{\text{gate}}=\{g^{(\ell,k)}\}_{\ell,k} for the full set of gate logits that HoS trains for a model.
For the token at position n n , the gated attention at layer ℓ \ell and head k k is HoS = a ~ ​ V ∈ ℝ d h , a ~ = softmax ⁡ ( q ​ K ⊤ d h + { log ⁡ σ ⁡ ( g c n , c j ) } j = 1 n ) ∈ ℝ 1 × n . \mathrm{HoS}=\tilde{a}V\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}},\qquad\tilde{a}=\operatorname{softmax}\!\left(\frac{qK^{\!\top}}{\sqrt{d_{h}}}\;+\;\biggl\{\log\sigma\bigl(g_{c_{n},c_{j}}\bigr)\biggr\}_{\!j=1}^{\,n}\right)\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times n}. (1) Here σ \sigma denotes the logistic sigmoid, so σ ⁡ ( g ) ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) \sigma(g)\in(0,1) scales each head’s attention to different channels: near 1 means the head attends normally to that channel, near 0 means the gate is closed.
Inside the softmax, each attention logit is exponentiated before the resulting weights are normalized. Adding log ⁡ σ ⁡ ( g ) \log\sigma(g) to a logit therefore multiplies its unnormalized attention weight by exp ⁡ ( log ⁡ σ ⁡ ( g ) ) = σ ⁡ ( g ) \exp(\log\sigma(g))=\sigma(g) . This is the same mechanism used for causal masking: adding − ∞ -\infty to a disallowed token makes its exponentiated weight zero. If every key receives the same gate, softmax cancels the common shift, so only differences between gates affect the output. The absolute scale of the initial logits is therefore irrelevant, and an input whose tokens all share one channel is processed exactly as in the base model.

The formulation above applies directly to Llama-3.3. GPT-OSS requires a slight modification because it includes an explicit attention sink: we treat the sink as an additional key-only channel, giving each head a gate table g ( ℓ , k ) ∈ ℝ C × ( C + 1 ) g^{(\ell,k)}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times(C+1)} . We give the sink-aware definition in Appendix D .

blocks.en: RL-Hammer on InjecAgent (black-box). HoS is more robust to the state-of-the-art black-box RL-Hammer attack than the undefended and SecAlign models on both GPT-OSS-20B and Llama-3.3-70B. Strikingly, it even achieves lower attack success rates than GPT-5.6-Luna. We follow the original RL-Hammer setup ( Wen et al., 2025b ) , using GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) to train a Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct attacker to rewrite an attacker goal into an injection optimized against a particular target model. Each main target model is paired with the same easy target model within its model family: undefended GPT-OSS-20B at low reasoning effort for the GPT-OSS experiments, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for the Llama experiments. We additionally train an attacker against GPT-5.6-Luna, paired with the same easy target as the GPT-OSS attackers.

Shaded cells show attacks against the model they were trained to defeat. The remaining cells measure attack transferability. blocks.en: 4.2 Benign utility
blocks.zh: 4.2 辅助工具

blocks.en: Heads of Security largely preserve base-model utility across standard question-answering and instruction-following benchmarks. In contrast, SecAlign and ASIDE perform comparably to the base model in zero-shot settings but degrade in several few-shot and multi-turn settings.
blocks.zh: 安保主管基本上在标准的问答和遵守指示的基准中保持基本模式的效用。 相比之下,SecAlign和ASIDE在零镜头设置中与基准模型具有可比性,但在几个几镜头和多回合设置中降解.

blocks.en: We hypothesize that these failures arise from broader fine-tuning on narrow data. All three defenses use similar training data, based on single-turn Alpaca data. Few-shot prompts and multi-turn conversations fall outside these training formats. SecAlign’s LoRA updates and ASIDE’s full fine-tuning may learn spurious correlations specific to those formats, whereas HoS’s restricted attention-gating parameterization preserves utility despite the narrow training distribution.
blocks.zh: 我们假设这些失败产生于对狭义数据的更广泛的微调。 所有三个防御工事都使用类似的训练数据,基于单回合阿尔帕卡数据. 很少镜头提示和多回合对话不属于这些培训形式。 SecAlign的LORA更新和ASIDE的全面微调可能会发现这些格式特有的虚假关联,而HOS的有限注意力分配参数化尽管培训分布很窄,但仍保持了效用.

blocks.en: Table 2: Utility on all-trusted prompts. SecAlign degrades sharply in several few-shot settings, while HoS remains close to the corresponding undefended model throughout.
blocks.zh: 表2:所有受托提示的效用。 secAlign在几个几发的设置中急剧降解,而HOS在整个过程中仍然接近相应的不设防模型.

blocks.en: Multiple-choice questions . We first evaluate on ARC-C ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , and MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , marking all prompt content trusted. We use the standard few-shot in-context learning setup for these benchmarks: the target question is prefixed by example questions and answers, which often help the model infer the task and response format.
blocks.zh: 多选题. 我们首先对ARC-C(Clark等人,2018年),GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年),MMLU(Hendrycks等人,2021年),以及MMLU-Pro(Wang等人,2024年)进行了评价,标注了所有可迅速信任的内容. 我们为这些基准使用标准数拍的文字学习设置:目标问题以示例问答为前缀,这往往有助于模型推断任务和响应格式.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that HoS remains close to the base model across zero-shot and few-shot settings on both model families. SecAlign and ASIDE also preserve zero-shot performance, but degrade in several few-shot settings. On GPT-OSS-20B, 5-shot MMLU-Pro accuracy falls from 68.3% for the base model to 59.4% with SecAlign and 52.1% with ASIDE, while HoS retains 67.2%. ASIDE also drops from the base model’s 82.3% to 74.1% on 5-shot MMLU, although it largely preserves GSM8K performance. The largest regressions occur for Meta-SecAlign-70B: accuracy falls to 2.0% on 1-shot GSM8K, 28.4% on 5-shot MMLU, and 16.1% on 5-shot MMLU-Pro. Manual inspection of Meta-SecAlign-70B’s outputs shows that it often answers one of the demonstrations rather than the final question. We investigate this behavior further in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 表2显示,在两个模范家庭的零镜头和少镜头设置中,HOS仍然接近基准模型. SecAlign和ASIDE也保留了零射的性能,但在几个几发的设置中降解. 在GPT-OSS-20B上,5发MMLU-Pro的精度从基础模型的68.3%下降到59.4%与SecAlign,52.1%与ASIDE,而HOS保留67.2%. 在5发MMLU上,ASIDE也从基准模型的82.3%下降到74.1%,尽管它在很大程度上保持了GSM8K的性能. 最大的回归发生在Meta-SecAlign-70B:1发GSM8K的精度下降到2.0%,5发MMLU的精度下降到28.4%,5发MMLU-Pro的精度下降16.1%. Meta-SecAlign-70B的输出值的人工检查显示,它经常回答一个演示而不是最后一个问题. 我们在附录H中进一步调查这种行为。

blocks.en: Multi-turn AlpacaFarm . We show that HoS preserves base-model utility across conversation turns, while SecAlign struggles to follow instructions that come later in the conversation. We evaluate Llama-3.3-70B and its SecAlign and HoS variants on multi-turn instruction following. We construct 100 three-turn conversations from AlpacaFarm ( Dubois et al., 2023 ) , pairing 100 instructions with an input field with 200 instructions without one. Each turn contains an independent task that should be completed regardless of the preceding turns.
blocks.zh: 多转阿尔帕卡法尔姆。 我们显示,HOS保留了基础模型的功能 跨对话转弯, 而SecAlign则挣扎着遵循 后面的对话指令。 我们对Llama-3.3-70B及其SecAlign和HOS的变体进行多回合指示的评价。 我们从AlpacaFarm(Dubois等人, 2023年)构筑了100个三回合对话, 每一回合都包含一项独立的任务,无论前几回合都应完成。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , the base model achieves 97–100% utility throughout, and HoS closely matches it. SecAlign is competitive on the first turn, but its utility drops to 43% when the input field appears at turn 2 and 75% when it appears at turn 3. The degradation also persists on later, fully trusted turns: when input appears at turn 1, utility on turns 2 and 3 falls to 71% and 82%.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,基本模型在全过程中达到97-100%的功用,HOS与之紧密匹配. secAlign在第一个回合是竞争性的,但是当输入字段出现在第2回合时,它的效用下降到了43%,当第3回合时则下降到75%. 退化还持续到以后的完全信任的转弯期:当第1转弯时,第2和第3转弯的功用下降到71%和82%。

blocks.en: Inspection of SecAlign’s transcripts shows a similar pattern to its few-shot failures: it continues answering an earlier instruction, treats a later instruction as data for the earlier one, or combines instructions across turns. For example, after a question about Thai food, it ignores an input field specifying chocolate chip cookies and writes a Pad Thai recipe. When next asked why it is a bad idea to give a mouse a cookie, it replies, “Now, let’s get back to cooking,” and continues the recipe. Appendix I provides representative transcripts.
blocks.zh: 检查SecAlign的笔录显示出与它的几发故障相似的规律:它继续回答先前的指令,将后发指令作为前发指令的数据,或者将指令相互结合. 例如,在对泰国食品提出疑问后,它忽略了指定巧克力芯片饼干的输入字段,并写出一个帕德泰菜谱. 当问及为何给老鼠一块饼干是个坏主意时, 附录一提供了有代表性的记录誊本。

For SecAlign, we follow its evaluation protocol and render tool outputs under the input role. We report clean utility, utility under attack, and attack success rate. Following the colors in Figure 2 (right), we refer to heads that shift attention away from untrusted content as red heads, and heads that shift attention toward untrusted content as blue heads. We hypothesize that blue heads help detect prompt injections. As Abdelnabi and Bagdasarian (2026) argue, agents should both resist injected instructions and recognize injection attempts.

blocks.en:
Role confusion. Recent work by Ye et al. (2026) argues for viewing prompt injection through the lens of role confusion.
According to this framing, successful attacks hinder the model’s ability to correctly attribute the source of the injected instruction.
For example, a malicious instruction in the untrusted tool output may be viewed by the model as originating from the user, and thus be erroneously trusted.
How does HoS affect the perceived roles?
blocks.zh:
角色混乱. Ye等人的近期著作. (2026年)主张通过角色混淆的镜头观看快速注入.
根据这一框架,成功的攻击阻碍了模型正确说明注射指示来源的能力。
例如,不可信工具输出中的恶意指令可能被模型视为源于用户,因此被错误地信任.
HoS如何影响感知角色?

blocks.en:
To test this, we adopt the role probes introduced by Ye et al. (2026) .
Role probes are linear probes on hidden activations that are trained on benign text with a neutral style, taken from the pretraining corpus and embedded in role tags.
Trained only on the tag signal by construction, these probes were shown to correctly identify the role of each part of the conversation in some scenarios.
Further, Ye et al. (2026) show that the Userness of the injected instruction token span (that is, how much its tokens are perceived as coming from the User role) is highly correlated with attack success rate.
We train the probes following the original recipe exactly.
For HoS, as in deployment, tool tokens are in the untrusted channel.
blocks.zh:
为了测试这一点,我们采用了Ye等人(2026年)引入的角色探测器.
角色探测器是在隐藏的激活器上的线性探测器,这些探测器以中性风格的良性文字训练,取自训练前体,并嵌入角色标记.
这些探测器仅通过构造在标记信号上进行训练,被显示在某些情景中能够正确识别对话每个部分的作用.
此外,Ye等人(2026年)表明,注射指示符号跨度的用户性(即其指示符号在多大程度上被视为来自用户角色)与攻击成功率密切相关。
我们按照原食谱训练探测器
对HOS来说,和部署一样,工具符在无人信任的频道中.

blocks.en:
To observe the effect of HoS on the perceived roles, we test GPT-OSS-20B and its HoS variant on AgentDojo.
First, using AgentDojo benign user tasks, we measure the accuracy (fraction of correctly classified tokens in a given role) for User and Tool roles, since confusion of those two roles is relevant for indirect prompt injection attacks.
Further, on the attacked version of AgentDojo, we compute the Userness of the injection token spans, which was shown to predict attack success rate in simple scenarios ( Ye et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
为了观察HOS对感知角色的影响,我们测试了GPT-OSS-20B及其在Agent Dojo上的HOS变体.
首先,使用AgentDojo良性用户任务,我们测量用户和工具角色的准确性(在特定角色中正确分类的代号的违反),因为这两个角色的混淆与间接即时注射攻击有关.
此外,在Agent Dojo被攻击的版本上,我们计算了注射符跨度的用户性,这被证明在简单的情景中可以预测攻击成功率(Ye等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
We report the observations in Figure 5 .
First, we find that HoS significantly improves the role perception for the tool outputs, compared to the base model.
Second, we find that HoS decreases the perceived Userness of the injection tokens in the attacked AgentDojo scenarios.
blocks.zh:
我们报告图5中的意见。
第一,我们发现,与基础模型相比,HOS大大改善了工具输出的作用感知.
其次,我们发现HOS减少了在被攻击的Dojo特工情景中注射符的感知用户.

blocks.en:
Overall, these results suggest that among other effects, the HoS mechanism improves the model’s role perception for the roles relevant to indirect prompt injection attacks.
Viewed through the lens of role confusion, this provides additional evidence that better role perception correlates with prompt injection robustness.
blocks.zh:
总的来说,这些结果表明,除其他影响外,联合系统机制提高了模型对间接即时注射攻击相关角色的作用认识。
从角色混淆的视角来看,这提供了更多的证据,表明更好的角色感知与迅速注入强健性相关。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Instruction–data separation is not an end-to-end defense. HoS enforces a trust boundary, but it does not decide which sources are trusted or which instructions the user has authorized. Moreover, some tasks legitimately require following instructions from external content, such as installing a software package. Strict instruction–data separation therefore applies only when that content is intended merely as data to process. We view it as one primitive in a broader defense, complementing instruction hierarchy ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) , which orders instructions by source, and contextual integrity ( Mireshghallah et al., 2024 ) , which captures context-sensitive authorization.
blocks.zh: 指令 - 数据分离不是一个端到端的防御. HoS执行一个信任边界,但它没有决定哪些来源是信任的,或者用户授权的指示是什么. 此外,有些任务合法地需要遵循外部内容的指示,例如安装软件包。 因此,严格指令-数据分离只适用于仅仅作为处理数据的内容。 我们将它视为广义防御中的原始,补充了指令等级(Wallace et al., 2024),它按源头命令指令,以及背景完整性(Mireshghallah et al., 2024),它捕捉了对上下文敏感的授权.

blocks.en: Training data is fixed. We train HoS and SecAlign on the same preference dataset to isolate the effect of the training algorithm. More diverse data, including multi-turn conversations, multiple instructions, and varied templates, would likely improve both methods and may mitigate SecAlign’s out-of-distribution failures. We do not claim these failures are inevitable. However, on identical data, SecAlign learns a shortcut, while HoS does not. Our claim is therefore that constraining the learning mechanism reduces its capacity to acquire unintended biases from the training distribution.
blocks.zh: 培训数据是固定的。 我们训练HOS和SecAlign在同一首选数据集上,以隔离训练算法的效果. 更多样化的数据,包括多回合对话、多条指示和各种模板,可能会改进这两种方法,并可能减轻SecAlign的分散故障。 我们并不声称这些失败是不可避免的。 然而,在相同数据上,SecAlign学习了一条快捷键,而HOS则没有. 因此,我们的主张是,限制学习机制削弱了其从培训分配中获得意想不到的偏见的能力。

blocks.en: The attacker moves second. Attackers can adapt their methods after seeing a defense, so no finite evaluation can establish security ( Nasr et al., 2026 ) . However, evaluated under the same attack budget, RL-Hammer and Claudini are less successful against HoS. This suggests that HoS is harder to attack than baselines, but does not rule out a successful attack by a motivated and capable adversary.
blocks.zh: 攻击者移动第二。 攻击者在看到防御后可以调整方法,因此任何有限的评价都不能建立安全性(Nasr等人,2026年). 然而,在同一攻击预算下评价,RL-Hammer和Claudini相对HOS来说并不成功. 这表明HOS攻击比基线更难,但不排除有动机和有能力的对手成功攻击.

blocks.en: HoS is designed for standard dense attention. Our method applies per-channel biases to pairwise attention logits before the softmax. It is therefore not directly compatible with linear attention architectures ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) where there is no explicit coefficient representing the attention to a specific key token. Extending the same trust constraint to pure linear attention architectures would require a different gating mechanism.
blocks.zh: HoS是为标准的密集关注而设计的. 我们的方法应用了每个通道的偏差,在软马克斯之前对注意力进行对等记录. 因此,它与线性关注架构(Yang等人,2024年;Yang等人,2025年a)并不直接兼容,因为其中没有明确的系数表示对特定关键符号的注意. 将同样的信任限制扩大到纯粹的线性关注架构,需要不同的定位机制。

blocks.en: Conclusion. We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a targeted intervention that enforces instruction–data separation by redistributing attention between trusted and untrusted tokens on a per-head basis. For the open-weight models we test, HoS is more robust to adaptive attacks and better at preserving utility outside the training distribution, while matching or improving SecAlign’s security–utility trade-off. These results show that instruction–data separation can be enforced by constraining attention rather than broadly fine-tuning model behavior.
blocks.zh: 结论。 我们介绍安全主管,这是一种有针对性的干预措施,通过在信任和不信任的象征之间逐一重新分配注意力,强制执行指令-数据分离。 对于我们测试的开放量级模型,HOS在适应性攻击上更加强大,在训练分配之外更好地保护实用性,同时匹配或改善 SecAlign的安全-实用性权衡。 这些结果显示,指令-数据分离可以通过限制注意力而不是广义的微调模型行为来执行.

blocks.en:
Prompt injection vulnerability and defenses. Prompt injection remains a major security problem for LLM applications, ranking first in OWASP Top 10 LLM security risks since 2024 ( OWASP Foundation, 2024a ; OWASP Foundation, 2024b ; OWASP Foundation, 2026 ) .
Indirect prompt injection occurs when an attacker places instructions in external content and induces the model to follow them. As LLMs increasingly gain access to external data and tools, this attack surface becomes more consequential.
Recent defenses aim to ensure that models follow authorized instructions from trusted sources while resisting malicious instructions in untrusted content.
Instruction hierarchy ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) prioritizes instructions by source, allowing the model to follow lower-priority instructions in external content only when they align with higher-priority ones in the user prompt. Instruction–data separation imposes a stricter constraint on content designated as data: the model may read and reason over it but must not follow instructions embedded within it ( Zverev et al., 2025 ) . For example, a model summarizing a webpage should describe its contents without following any embedded instructions. Enforcing this boundary is challenging because models can mistake untrusted content for user instructions through role confusion ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . Some workflows, however, require following instructions from external content, such as skill files ( Schmotz et al., 2026 ) , and deciding which instructions should be followed is a context-dependent problem studied through contextual integrity ( Abdelnabi and Bagdasarian, 2026 ) . HoS focuses on improving prompt injection robustness in settings with a defined instruction–data boundary.
blocks.zh:
迅速注射和防御 快速注射仍然是LLM应用的主要安全问题,自2024年以来,在OWASP Top 10 LLM安全风险中排名第一(OWASP Foundation,2024a;OWASP Foundation,2024b;OWASP Foundation,2026).
间接即时注射是指攻击者将指令放入外部内容,并诱导模型遵循. 随着LLMs越来越多地获得外部数据和工具,这种攻击表面变得更为间接.
近期的防御旨在确保模型遵循来自可信来源的授权指令,同时抵制内容不可信的恶意指令.
指令层级(Wallace et al., 2024)按源头排列指令,只允许模型在外部内容中遵循低优先级指令,只有在用户提示中与高优先级指令一致时才允许. 指令-数据分离对被指定为数据的内容施加了更严格的限制:该模型可以读取并解释其原因,但不得遵循嵌入其中的指示(Zverev等人,2025年)。 例如,一个总结网页的模型应该对其内容进行描述,而不遵循任何嵌入式指令. 强制实施这个边界是具有挑战性的,因为模型可以通过角色混淆(Ye et al., 2026)错误地将不可信内容用于用户指令. 然而,有些工作流程需要遵循来自外部内容的指示,如技能文件(Schmotz等人,2026年),并决定应当遵循哪些指示,是一个通过背景完整性研究的取决于背景的问题(Abdelnabi和Bagdasarian,2026年)。 HoS 专注于在有定义指令-数据边界的环境下提高快速注入强度.

blocks.en: Unlike defenses that strengthen the underlying model, CaMeL ( Debenedetti et al., 2025 ) is a system-level defense that enforces security policies on tool calls and information flows even if the underlying model remains vulnerable, but it does not defend against prompt injection attacks that only affect the target model’s text output (e.g., biasing the summary of a webpage).
blocks.zh: 与强化基本模型的防御不同,CaMeL(Debederetti等人,2025年)是一种系统层面的防御,即使基本模型仍然脆弱,仍对工具呼叫和信息流执行安全政策,但它并不针对仅影响目标模型文本输出的即时注射攻击(如偏向网页摘要)进行防御.

blocks.en: Attention head specialization. Existing literature shows that attention heads often develop narrow and well-defined purposes. A small subset of heads is important for translation ( Voita et al., 2019 ) ; induction heads copy token sequences that previously appeared in context ( Elhage et al., 2021 ) ; 26 heads are responsible for indirect-object identification in GPT-2 small ( Wang et al., 2023 ) ; copy-suppression heads suppress naive in-context copying to improve next-token prediction ( McDougall et al., 2024 ) ; and retrieval heads recover relevant information from long contexts ( Wu et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 注意头部专业。 现有文献显示,关注头常常发展出狭隘和明确的目的. 少量头像对翻译很重要(Voita等人,2019年);诱导头像复制了以前出现于上下文的符号序列(Elhage等人,2021年);26头像负责GPT-2小片中的间接对象识别(Wang等人,2023年);复制头像压制天真的内文复制,以改善下下文预测(McDougall等人,2024年);检索头像从长篇背景中恢复相关信息(Wu等人,2025年b).

blocks.en: Recent work suggests that instruction following similarly relies on specialized attention mechanisms. PASTA ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) reweights attention from a small subset of heads so that they pay more attention to user-specified parts of the prompt, while InstABoost ( Guardieiro et al., 2025 ) strengthens instruction following by directly increasing attention to instruction tokens. Relatedly, Causal Head Gating ( Nam et al., 2025 ) identifies a separable head-level circuit for instruction following that can be disabled while largely preserving other capabilities.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作表明,遵循同样的指示也依赖于专门关注机制。 PATA(Zhang et al., 2024)从小片头重新对注意力进行加权,这样他们就会更加注意提示中用户指定的部分,而InstABoost(Guardieiro et al., 2025)则通过直接增加对指示符的注意来加强后续指示. 与此相关, 恶性头痛 (Nam et al.,2025)确定一个可分离的头级电路,用于在基本保留其他能力的同时可禁用的指导。

blocks.en: Attention and adversarial instructions. Beyond general head specialization, prior work has linked attention directly to adversarial instruction following. Xue et al. (2025) show that adversarial prompts can subvert rule-based inference by suppressing attention to legitimate rules. Related work on jailbreaks shows that GCG ( Zou et al., 2023 ) suffixes can hijack model contextualization, and that suppressing attention components involved in this mechanism can mitigate such attacks ( Ben-Tov et al., 2026 ) , while Yin et al. (2026) show that jailbreaks can suppress a small set of safety-relevant heads.
blocks.zh: 注意和对抗指令。 除了一般主管专业之外,以前的工作将注意力直接与随后的对抗性教学联系起来。 薛等人(2025年)表明,对抗性诱因可以通过压制对合法规则的注意来颠覆基于规则的推论. 关于越狱的相关研究表明,GCG(Zou等人,2023年)的后缀可以劫持模型上下文,而这种机制中涉及的压制注意力组件可以减轻这种攻击(Ben-Tov等人,2026年),而Yin等人(2026年)则表明越狱可以压制一组与安全相关的小头.

blocks.en: Under prompt injection, specific attention heads shift their attention from the benign instruction to the malicious instruction embedded in the data part ( Hung et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ) . Relatedly, residual stream activations can distinguish inputs containing injected instructions ( Abdelnabi et al., 2025a ) or act as features for a prompt injection detector ( Wen et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh: 在迅速注射的情况下,特别注意头将注意力从良性指示转移到嵌入数据部分的恶意指示(Hung等人,2025年;Zhong等人,2026年)。 与此相关的是,残留电流激活可以区分含有注入指令(Abdelnabi等人,2025a)或作为快速注入探测器的特征(Wen等人,2025a)。 。 。 。

blocks.en: HoS builds upon these observations: by conditioning each head’s gate on the query and key channels, we allow attention heads responsible for instruction following to learn to operate normally on trusted input while restricting how they attend to untrusted input.
blocks.zh: HOS基于这些观察:通过在查询和关键通道上对每个头部的大门进行调节,我们允许负责指示的注意负责人学习如何正常操作可信输入,同时限制他们如何处理不信任输入。

blocks.en: Llama gates mostly shift attention away from untrusted content. Positive values are predominant in Figure 6 , as in GPT-OSS-20B ( Figure 2 , right), indicating that most heads reduce their relative attention to untrusted keys for trusted queries. A minority of heads shift in the opposite direction. This pattern is consistent with different heads serving complementary roles: some may suppress the influence of untrusted instructions, while others retain access to untrusted content needed for the task. The gate values alone do not establish these functions.
blocks.zh: Llama大门主要转移注意力 远离不信任的内容。 正值在图6中占主导地位,如GPT-OSS-20B中(图2,右),表明大多数头都减少了对信任查询的不可信密钥的相对关注。 少数人头朝相反方向移动。 这种模式与担任互补角色的不同头目一致:有些可能会压制不可信指令的影响,而另一些则保留对任务所需的不可信内容的获取. 门值本身并不能确定这些功能。

blocks.en: Llama’s largest shifts cluster in middle and late layers. The heatmap shows relatively small shifts before layer 10 and throughout much of layers 40–70. Larger shifts cluster around layers 15–40, with another cluster near layers 70–80. Within these regions, heads differ in both the magnitude and direction of their shifts, consistent with HoS learning a distinct redistribution for each head rather than uniformly suppressing untrusted content.
blocks.zh: Llama最大的中层和后层转向集群。 热图显示第10层之前和大部分第40至70层的移动较小。 更大的转向集围绕层15–40,另一组接近层70–80. 在这些区域中,头头在转移的规模和方向上都有所不同,这与协调办学习对每个头头进行不同的再分配而不是统一压制不信任的内容是一致的。

blocks.en: The layer structure differs from GPT-OSS. GPT-OSS-20B shows a more even distribution of shifts across layers ( Figure 2 , right). One possible explanation is the architectural difference: GPT-OSS is shallower and alternates local and full attention, whereas Llama uses full attention throughout. These differences may affect where information from untrusted content is processed, but the heatmaps alone do not establish why the layer patterns differ.
blocks.zh: 层结构与GPT-OSS不同. GPT-OSS-20B显示各层变化的分布较为均匀(图2,右)。 一种可能的解释是建筑差异:GPT-OSS是比较浅和替代的局部和充分关注,而Llama则在整个过程中充分关注。 这些差异可能会影响来自不可信内容的信息的处理,但仅热图并不能确定层图型为何不同.

blocks.en: GPT-OSS appends a learned scalar sink logit s ( ℓ , k ) s^{(\ell,k)} to each head’s content logits before the softmax. This is a pretrained model parameter that remains frozen during HoS training; the additional sink gate is trainable. The probability assigned to the sink is discarded before the attention weights are multiplied by V V , without renormalizing the remaining weights, allowing a head to place probability mass on no content token.

The sink can appear only as a key, so the resulting table has shape C × ( C + 1 ) C\times(C+1) rather than ( C + 1 ) × ( C + 1 ) (C+1)\times(C+1) . In the implementation, the final column is stored separately as one sink gate per query channel and head; this is equivalent to the table above.

Gating the sink preserves the uniform-gate no-op property described in Section 3.2 . Adding the same bias to all content logits but not the sink changes the allocation of attention between content and sink. If the sink receives that same bias, all n + 1 n+1 logits share a common shift, which softmax cancels in exact arithmetic. This holds at initialization because content and sink gates start at the same value. After training, even an input whose tokens all share one channel can change the output if that channel’s gate differs from the sink gate. Sliding-window layers use the same formulation with out-of-window content keys masked; the sink remains available independently of the window.

Targets are served through the vLLM gated engine with tensor parallelism 4, greedy decoding, a 4,096-token context cap, and a 512-token completion cap. Llama has no reasoning-effort control. SecAlign uses the released rank-32 adapter, with tool outputs rendered under the input role. Each attack set is generated once and replayed against every target.
blocks.zh: 我们使用与GPT-OSS相同的攻击者食谱和310/100列车/测试分路,Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct是每次Llama跑的轻松目标. 目标通过VLLM门式引擎提供,具有拉诺并行性4,贪婪的解码,4,096个托肯上下文盖,以及512个托肯完成盖. Llama没有推理能力控制。 SecAlign使用已发布的等级-32适配器,在输入角色下提供工具输出. 每一套攻击都产生一次,然后对每个目标重播.

blocks.en: Transfer success varies substantially across targets. We evaluate the three low-effort GPT-OSS attackers from Table 8 against models served through OpenRouter with native tool calling, and against GPT-OSS-120B served locally. Each attacker generates one fixed set of 100 cached injections shared across these targets. The attackers were optimized against GPT-OSS-20B, not these evaluation targets, so low transfer ASR does not establish robustness to target-adaptive attacks. Table 11 reports the results.
blocks.zh: 各个目标之间的转让成功率差别很大。 我们从表8评估三名低功率的GPT-OSS攻击者与通过OpenRouter使用本地工具呼叫的模型相比, 每个攻击者产生一组固定的100个缓存注射,在这些目标之间共享. 攻击者被优化了针对GPT-OSS-20B,而不是这些评价目标,因此低转移ASR不能建立强力以适应目标攻击. 表11报告了结果。

blocks.en: At medium evaluation effort, the SecAlign-trained attacker reaches 91% ASR on Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite and 75% on GPT-OSS-120B; it also reaches 90% on GPT-4o-mini, which has no reasoning-effort setting. Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, and the evaluated GPT-5 variants have at most 3% ASR in the medium-effort columns. At low effort, however, Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite reaches 45%. Increased requested reasoning effort is thus associated with lower transfer ASR for some targets, but the pattern is not universal: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite becomes more vulnerable to all three attackers.
blocks.zh: 在中等评价中,SecAlign训练的攻击者在双子座3.1 Flash-Lite上达到91%的ASR,在GPT-OSS-120B上达到75%;在GPT-4o-mini上也达到了90%,没有推理-效果设置. Claude Haiku 4.5,双子座3.5 Flash-Lite,以及被评价的GPT-5变种在中等功率列中最高拥有3%的ASR. 然而在低努力度下,双子座3.5闪电Lite达到了45%. 因此,要求增加的推理努力与一些目标的转移ASR降低有关,但模式并不普遍:双子座3.1 Flash-Lite对所有三个攻击者都更加脆弱.

blocks.en: E.2 SecAlign on InjecAgent
blocks.zh: E.2 对InjecAgent 的编码

blocks.en: Prompt layout and scoring substantially affect the measured InjecAgent ASR. Our native-tool protocol gives 5% ASR for Meta-SecAlign-70B and 16% for the undefended Llama model on the 100 held-out cases with basic injections ( Table 6 ). The agent prompt, user task, previous assistant tool call, and tool definitions remain trusted; only the tool response containing the injection is untrusted. Success requires a parsed first tool call naming the attacker’s tool.
blocks.zh: 快速布局和评分对测量的InjecAgent ASR有重大影响。 我们的本地工具协议为Meta-SecAlign-70B提供了5%的ASR,为100个持有基本注射的病例提供了16%的无防守Llama模型(表6)。 代理即时,用户任务,之前的助手工具呼叫,工具定义仍然可信;只有包含注入的工具响应是不信任的. 成功需要解析的第一个工具调用攻击者的工具命名 。

blocks.en: The SecAlign evaluation harness ( Chen et al., 2025c ) reports 0.5% ASR on InjecAgent. Here we investigate the difference. The SecAlign harness uses InjecAgent’s ReAct text format. With instruction hierarchy enabled, one input message contains the tool definitions, user task, and full Thought/Action/Action Input/Observation scratchpad. Effectively, under this setup, tool definitions end up in the untrusted input role, affecting the model’s ability to call tools.
blocks.zh: SecAlign评价工具(Chen等人,2025年c)报告在InjecAgent上为0.5%。 在这里,我们调查区别。 secAlign 控制器使用 InjecAgent 的 ReAct 文本格式 。 启用指令等级后,一个输入信息包含工具定义,用户任务,以及完整的思念/行动/行动输入/观察抓图. 实际上,在这个设置下,工具定义最终会出现在不信任的输入角色中,影响了模型调用工具的能力.

blocks.en: Its default setup also appends a reminder of the user’s task (the “sandwich” defense). The ReAct parser classifies outputs as successful, valid but unsuccessful, or invalid; ASR over all cases counts invalid outputs as attack failures. The released model-card evaluation additionally uses 1,054 direct-harm and data-stealing cases and reports the higher ASR of the basic and enhanced settings, whereas our primary evaluation uses 100 held-out direct-harm cases.
blocks.zh: 其默认设置还附加了用户任务的提醒("sandwich"防御). ReAct 解析器将输出归类为成功,有效但失败或无效; ASR 在所有情况下将无效输出算作攻击失败. 公布的模型卡评价还使用了1 054个直接伤害和数据偷盗案例,并报告了基本和强化环境的较高ASR,而我们的主要评价则使用了100个搁置的直接伤害案例。

blocks.en: Table 12 reproduces the SecAlign harness layout on the same served weights, using the 100 held-out cases and the full 510-case direct-harm set. SecAlign produces invalid ReAct outputs on 90–95% of the held-out cases across these settings. Consequently, its low ASR under this protocol cannot alone establish that it completes legitimate tasks while rejecting injections. For the undefended model, adding the sandwich reminder reduces basic-injection ASR from 46% to 10% with instruction hierarchy enabled; the enhanced injection still reaches 59%. These measurements differ in prompt layout, trust assignment, parsing, and case selection, so they are not directly comparable to the native-tool results.
blocks.zh: 表12采用了100件搁置案件和510件全部直接伤害案,在相同的服务重量上复制了SecAlign套装。 secAlign在这些设置中90-95%的搁置案件上生成无效的ReAct输出. 因此,议定书规定的低水平的ASR不能单独确定它完成合法任务而拒绝注射。 对于不设防的型号,加入三明治提醒会将基本注射ASR从46%降至10%,并启用指令分级;强化注射仍然达到59%. 这些测量在即时布局,信任分配,解析,以及案例选择上各不相同,因此它们与本土工具结果不具有直接可比性.

blocks.en: Table 12: SecAlign’s InjecAgent protocol reproduced on the same model weights. Direct-harm cases only. “Sandwich” adds a reminder of the user’s task; IH=1 places the ReAct prompt in the untrusted input role, while IH=0 places it in the user role. The parser counts successful, unsuccessful valid, and invalid outputs. ASR-all is successes divided by all cases; ASR-valid is successes divided by valid outputs. Our native-tool protocol on the same 100 held-out cases gives basic/enhanced ASRs of 16%/26% for Llama and 5%/3% for SecAlign.
blocks.zh: 表12: SecAlign的InjecAgent协议在同一模型权重上复制. 只有直接伤害案件。 "Sandwich"增加了对用户任务的提醒;IH=1将ReAct的提示放在不信任的输入角色中,而IH=0将其放在用户角色中. 解析器计数成功、 无效和无效的输出 。 ASR是将成功分为所有情况;ASR是将成功分为有效产出。 我们的本地工具协议在同一100个被搁置的案例中,Llama的基本/强化ASR为16%/26%,SecAlign为5%/3%。

blocks.en: Across the settings in Table 12 , 690 of SecAlign’s 921 invalid outputs repeat the user’s tool call without a next step, 179 fabricate an observation, and 46 omit an observation; the remaining six contain too many actions or an unavailable tool. The undefended model produces 203 invalid outputs, mostly repetitions without a next step (152) or with a fabricated observation (42). These totals aggregate overlapping case sets across evaluation conditions. The reproduction follows each harness’s choice of tool-response field, including the surrounding quotes in the basic ReAct setting. SecAlign’s adapter scaling uses α = 8 \alpha=8 in both protocols.
blocks.zh: 在表12的设置中, SecAlign 921 无效输出的 690 重复了用户的工具调用, 没有下一步, 179 编造了一个观察, 46 省略了一个观察; 其余的 6 包含太多的动作或一个没有的工具 。 无防守型号产生203个无效输出,大多数重复没有下一步(152个),或者有编造的观察(42个). 这些总数使各评价条件相互重叠的案件组合合在一起。 复制遵循了每种工具的反应领域选择,包括基本ReAct设定中的周围引文. SecAlign的适配器缩放在两个协议中都使用α=8\alpha=8.

blocks.zh: E.3 攻击实例

blocks.en: Here we provide attack examples generated by trained RL-Hammer attackers.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们提供了训练有素的RL-Hammer攻击者产生的攻击例子.

blocks.en: The blocks below reproduce the saved injection texts for two matched held-out goals, from attackers optimized against SecAlign and HoS. Success and failure labels are those recorded with the original examples against each attacker’s training target. Character counts describe the displayed files, excluding their terminal newline.
blocks.zh: 下面的块重现了两个匹配的阻截目标所保存的注射文字,来自针对 SecAlign 和 HoS 的优化攻击者。 成功和失败标签是记录在每一个攻击者训练目标的原始例子中的。 字符计数描述显示的文件,不包括其终端新线.

blocks.en: The two attackers use different strategies in these examples. The SecAlign-optimized injections are long and repetitive: they repeatedly restate the requested action and ask the model to summarize its outcome. The HoS-optimized injections are shorter, assert that permissions and credentials are already available, invoke evaluation of task completion, and prescribe a response format. This contrast appears in both the note-sharing and appointment examples. The recorded SecAlign-targeted attacks succeed, while the HoS-targeted attacks fail. These examples illustrate different learned strategies, although they do not isolate which features account for success or failure.
blocks.zh: 两位攻击者在这些例子中采用了不同的策略. secAlign-优化注射是长而重复的:它们反复重复所要求的动作,并要求模型总结其结果. 综合系统优化注射时间较短,声称已有授权和证书,援引对任务完成情况的评价,并规定了答复格式。 这种对比出现在说明分享和任命的例子中。 有记录的SecAlign目标攻击成功,而HOS目标攻击失败. 这些例子说明了不同的学习战略,尽管它们并不孤立哪些特征是成功或失败的。

Sol’s task was to break HoS-defended GPT-OSS-20B; everything that would

behaviours, the model and HoS checkpoint, the seed, the suffix length, the

test. Inside that envelope it could read anything: model weights, gate
values, optimizer source, gradients, and every previous transcript and loss.
We asked it to keep a research log and to keep proposing mechanistically

evaluation set, which we used once, after selection.

blocks.en: White-box optimization costs far more against Llama-3.3-70B than against GPT-OSS-20B, which uses roughly 3B active parameters per forward pass compared with Llama’s 70B. We raised the per-attack budget 50 × 50\times to compensate, from 10 17 10^{17} to × 10 18 5\!\times\!10^{18} FLOPs, and even then could afford only 20 AgentDojo examples. At the full budget, V38 succeeds on 12/20 examples against the base model, 6/20 against Meta-SecAlign-70B, and 7/20 against HoS. One example moves ASR by five percentage points, so the two defenses are separated by a single example: both reduce attack success relative to the base model, and this sample cannot rank them against each other.

blocks.en: Panels (b) and (c) run claudini_v45 on the same 100-example AgentDojo and InjecAgent sets and the same 10 17 10^{17} -FLOP budget as Figure 2 (left). It is weaker than V38 in all six cells, and it still finds HoS hardest: 48% ASR on AgentDojo and 2% on InjecAgent, against 55% and 31% for the undefended model. It ranks the two baselines differently, though. On AgentDojo it reaches 71% against SecAlign but only 55% against the undefended model, a 16-point gap that V38 does not reproduce, finding the two level at 83% and 82%. An attack that has not been adapted to the defense it faces therefore understates both the ceiling and the similarity of the baselines, which is why the main text reports V38.

blocks.en: G.1 Benchmarks and metrics

blocks.en: We run both benchmarks through the AgentDojo harness, using the VLLM_PARSED format for GPT-OSS-20B and LOCAL for Llama-3.3-70B. Across all models and defenses, we impose a 12,288-token limit on the full trajectory and allow at most 8,192 generated tokens in any single model call. If either limit is exceeded, the trajectory is terminated and both the user task and the injected task are scored as failed.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-OSS-20B的VLLM_PARSED格式和Llama-3.3-70B的LOCAL格式,通过Agent Dojo 的吊带运行两种基准。 在所有模型和防御中,我们规定整个轨迹的12 288个托肯限制,最多允许在任何单一模型调用中产生8 192个令牌。 如果超过任一限制,则终止轨迹,并将用户任务和注入任务都评为失败。

blocks.en: We exclude tasks that can exceed the context limit on the base model. For GPT-OSS-20B, we exclude Workspace user tasks 35 and 38 from AgentDojo; for Llama-3.3-70B, we exclude Workspace user tasks 26, 27, 34, 35, and 38. We exclude no tasks from AgentDyn.

blocks.en: AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) pairs legitimate user tasks with injected tasks in tool outputs across four environments: Workspace, Slack, Banking, and Travel. AgentDyn uses the same harness for three additional environments: Shopping, GitHub, and Daily Life. We evaluate both with the important_instructions attack. Utility is the fraction of legitimate user tasks completed, and attack success rate (ASR) is the fraction of trajectories in which the injected task is completed; both are determined by deterministic checks of the final environment state. Clean utility is measured without an injection, whereas utility under attack is averaged over user-task–injection-task combinations.
blocks.zh: Agent Dojo(Debederetti等人,2024年)将正当的用户任务与工具输出中注入的任务对齐,跨越四个环境:工作空间,Slack,Banking,和Travel. 探员 Dyn对另外三个环境使用相同的吊带:购物,GitHub和Daily Life. 我们用重要的指令来评估两者 工具是完成的合法用户任务的一小部分,攻击成功率(ASR)是完成注入任务的轨迹的一小部分;两者都由最终环境状态的确定性检查决定. 干净的功用在没有注入的情况下进行测量,而受到攻击的功用则平均于用户任务-注射-任务组合。

blocks.en: For HoS, every tool-output token is assigned to the untrusted channel. For SecAlign, we follow the authors’ evaluation strategy: tool outputs are escaped and remapped to the input role, marking them as data rather than instructions.
blocks.zh: 对于HOS来说,每个工具输出符都分配到不可信频道. 就SecAlign而言,我们遵循作者的评价策略:工具输出被逃脱,并重塑到输入角色,将其标记为数据而不是指示.

blocks.en: WASP ( Evtimov et al., 2026 ) evaluates a browsing agent on webpages containing goal-hijacking injections. Its clean-utility set contains 37 tasks, and its security set contains 84 combinations of user tasks, injection tasks, and injection formats (plain text injection and URL injection) across Reddit and GitLab environments. Following Chen et al. (2025c) , we represent webpages as accessibility trees (hierarchical text descriptions of their relevant elements) and use a 24K-token context window.
blocks.zh: WASP(Evtimov等人,2026年)在网页上评价一个浏览剂,其中包含抢门注射. 其干净的通用集包含37项任务,其安全集包含84项组合的用户任务,注入任务,以及跨越Reddit和GitLab环境的注入格式(平面文字注入和URL注入). 接下来 Chen et al. (2025c),我们代表网页作为无障碍树(其相关元素的等级文本描述),并使用24K-token上下文窗口.

blocks.en: Most elements in WASP webpages are fixed browser interface elements that cannot be modified by users or prompt injection attackers, such as buttons to post comments on Reddit and GitLab. For HoS and ASIDE, we treat these tokens as trusted while treating all elements that could have user-generated content, such as GitLab issue titles and descriptions, Reddit post content, and URLs, as untrusted.
blocks.zh: WASP网页中的大多数元素是固定浏览器界面元素,用户或即时注射攻击者无法修改,如在Reddit和GitLab上张贴评论的按钮. 对HOS和ASIDE来说,我们将这些令牌视为可信赖的,同时将GitLab发布标题和描述,Reddit帖内容,URL等所有可能拥有用户生成内容的元素视为不可信赖.

blocks.en: LLMail-Inject ( Abdelnabi et al., 2025b ) consists of adaptive, human-written injections submitted to a public challenge. The model acts as an email assistant asked to summarize retrieved emails, while the attack attempts to make it call send_email to contact the attacker. We evaluate a random sample of 4,000 Phase-1 submissions, with 1,000 drawn from each of the four challenge levels. The benchmark natively measures only whether the attack succeeds. We additionally measure utility under attack with Claude Sonnet 5, counting a response as successful when it thematically covers every task-relevant email, even if the summary appears inside a fabricated tool call.
blocks.zh: LLMail-Inject(Abdelnabi等人,2025年b)包括适应性强的人体书面注射,提交公众质疑. 该模型充当了被请求的电子邮件助手,对检索的电子邮件进行总结,而攻击试图让它调用spend_email来联系攻击者. 我们随机抽样评估4 000份第1阶段提交材料,其中1 000份来自四个挑战级别。 基准本身仅衡量攻击是否成功。 我们用Claude Sonnet 5来进一步衡量受到攻击的效用,

blocks.en: On LLMail-Inject, SecAlign raises ASR from 2.1% for the base model to 12.7% ( Table 3 ). It emits a tool call on 29.95% of the 4,000 samples, compared with 2.40% for the base model and 0.00% for HoS. This rate counts any tool call, not only successful calls to the attacker’s tool. As discussed in Section 4.3 , SecAlign often makes unnecessary or fabricated tool calls and sometimes adopts attacker-specified recipients and email bodies from the untrusted content.
blocks.zh: 在LLMail-Inject上,SecAlign将ASR从基本模型的2.1%提高到12.7%(表3)。 它向4000个样本中29.95%的样本发出工具调用,而基模为2.40%,HOS为0.0%. 不仅成功调用攻击者的工具。 如第4.3节所述,SecAlign经常不必要地或编造工具电话,有时还采用攻击者指定的收件人和来自不可信内容的电子邮件机构。

blocks.en: On WASP, HoS achieves 62.2% clean utility, compared with 66.5% for the base model and 62.7% for SecAlign. Under attack, HoS achieves 81.4% utility, versus 62.4% and 79.8%, respectively, while reducing ASR to 1.4%, compared with 7.6% and 2.4%. These are means over five runs, consistent with Table 3 .

blocks.en: Appendix J Training setup
blocks.zh: 附录J 培训设置

blocks.en: J.1 Models and trainable parameters
blocks.zh: J.1 模型和可训练参数

blocks.en: We train HoS on GPT-OSS-20B and Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, freezing all base-model weights and saving only the learned gates. We also train a SecAlign LoRA adapter for GPT-OSS-20B. For Llama, we use the released facebook/Meta-SecAlign-70B adapter without modification. Table 15 summarizes the resulting parameter counts.
blocks.zh: 我们用GPT-OSS-20B和Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct来训练HOS,冻结所有基建模型重量,只节省学门. 我们还为GPT-OSS-20B培训一个SecAlign LoRA适配器. 对于Llama,我们不用修改就使用已发布的facebook/Meta-SecAlign-70B适配器. 表15汇总了由此产生的参数数。

blocks.en: Table 15: Trainable components and parameter counts. Components trained for each model and defense, their provenance, and the number of trainable parameters. The base model is frozen in every row. “Released” denotes the unmodified checkpoint from Chen et al. (2025c) ; all other defenses are trained by us.
blocks.zh: 表15:可训练部件和参数数。 为每个模型和防御、其来源和可训练参数数量培训的部件。 基型每行都冷冻. “释放”指陈等人(2025年c)的未经修改的检查站;所有其他防卫人员由我们训练。

blocks.en: Each HoS layer has a gate tensor of shape 3 × 3 × 64 3\times 3\times 64 , corresponding to query channel, key channel, and attention head. GPT-OSS has 24 layers and an additional 3 × 64 3\times 64 sink-gate tensor per layer, giving 18,432 parameters in total. Llama has 80 layers and no explicit sink gate, giving 46,080 parameters. Gate logits are initialized to 1, so each sigmoid gate initially equals σ ⁡ ( 1 ) = 0.731 \sigma(1)=0.731 . Because every channel pair begins with the same value, this initialization is a no-op under softmax; GPT-OSS’s sink is gated separately to preserve this property. We apply no explicit gate regularization.
blocks.zh: 每个HOS层都有一个形状为3×3×64 3×Times 3×Times 64的闸门显示器,对应查询通道,关键通道,以及注意力头. GPT-OSS有24层,每层新增3×64 3\时64个沉船门拉伸器,总共给出18,432个参数. Llama有80层,没有明显的下沉门,给出46,080个参数. 门对数初始化为1,因此每个西格莫德门最初等于\\\(1)=0.731\西格玛(1)=0.731. 因为每个信道对从同一个值开始,这种初始化在软马克斯下是无操作的;GPT-OSS的槽被单独封门来保存这个属性. 我们没有实行明确的大门正规化。

blocks.en: For our GPT-OSS SecAlign baseline, LoRA uses rank 64, α = 8 \alpha=8 , zero dropout, and no bias on the attention q q and v v projections. The mixture-of-experts gate_up_proj and down_proj tensors are adapted at rank 2. The released Llama SecAlign adapter uses rank 32 and α = 8 \alpha=8 , targeting the q q , v v , gate, up, and down projections.
blocks.zh: 对于我们的GPT-OSS SecAlign基线,LORA使用排名64,α = 8\alpha=8,零退学,对注意q和v预测没有偏见. 专家混合门_上_proj 和下_proj 客机按级别调整 2. 释放的Llama SecAlign适配器使用第32位和α = 8\alpha=8位,瞄准q q,v,门,上,下预测.

blocks.en: J.2 Optimization
blocks.zh: J.2 优化

blocks.en: All HoS and SecAlign models we train use distributed DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) with AdamW, zero weight decay, a cosine learning-rate schedule with no warmup, gradient clipping at 1.0, bfloat16 precision, and activation checkpointing. We use DPO β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 with no label smoothing. Training runs on eight H100 80GB GPUs with a per-device batch size of 1 and eight gradient-accumulation steps, for an effective batch size of 64. Model-specific settings are given in Table 16 .
blocks.zh: 所有HOS和SecAlign模型 我们训练使用分布式DPO(Rafailov等人,2023年)与AdamW,零重量衰减,一个没有热量的余弦学习率表,梯度剪切1.0,bfloat16精度,以及激活检查. 我们使用 DPO β = 0.1\β = 0.1 没有标签平滑. 培训以8个H100 80GB GPU进行,每台设备的批量尺寸为1个,8个梯度积累步骤,有效批量尺寸为64个。 具体模式设置见表16。

blocks.en: Table 16: Training hyperparameters. Model-specific settings for the defenses trained by us. Learning rate is swept independently for both GPT-OSS defenses; Llama HoS uses a single learning rate. All runs use an effective batch size of 64, and dashes denote settings that do not apply.
blocks.zh: 表16:培训超参数。 我们训练的防御工事的模型设置 两种GPT-OSS防御的学习率独立扫射;Llama HoS采用单一的学习率. 所有运行使用有效的批量大小为64,破折号表示不适用的设置.

blocks.en: The gate and LoRA learning rates are swept separately because they parameterize objects of very different scale: tens of thousands of gate logits versus tens of millions of adapter parameters. The headline GPT-OSS HoS result uses learning rate 0.1; the full security–utility sweep is reported in Table 13 .
blocks.zh: 门和LORA的学习率被分开扫描,因为它们将非常不同尺度的物体参数化:数以万计的门对数对数以千万计的适配参数. 标题GPT-OSS HoS结果采用学习率0.1;全部安全-实用性扫描见表13。

blocks.en: J.3 Preference data
blocks.zh: J.3 优先数据

blocks.en: Both model families use preference pairs derived from the synthetic AlpacaFarm injection data used for SecAlign ( Chen et al., 2025c ) . For GPT-OSS, we additionally generate reasoning traces for each preference option using GPT-OSS-120B.
blocks.zh: 两个模范家庭都使用从SecAlign(Chen等人,2025年c)使用的合成阿尔帕卡法尔姆注射数据中得出的首选配对. 对于GPT-OSS,我们使用GPT-OSS-120B为每个偏好选项额外生成推理痕迹.

blocks.en: J.4 Channel assignment
blocks.zh: J.4 频道任务

blocks.en: HoS uses three channels: trusted, untrusted, and template. System and user content is trusted; content in the SecAlign input field is untrusted; and chat-template tokens such as role headers belong to the template channel. The model’s generated tokens are assigned to the trusted channel. For GPT-OSS, the assistant’s final channel prefix is kept outside the untrusted span.
blocks.zh: HoS使用三个频道:信任,不信任,模板. 系统和用户内容是可信的;SecAlign输入字段中的内容是不可信的;而聊天-模板符号,如角色头属于模板通道. 该模型生成的符号被分配到可信任的频道. 对 GPT- OSS 来说, 助手的最后一个频道前缀被保存在未信任的跨度之外 。

blocks.en: The GPT-OSS SecAlign configuration instead renders the input field as its own delimited header turn, following the SecAlign mechanism. Apart from this placement of the untrusted span and the defense-specific trainable parameters, the GPT-OSS HoS and SecAlign configurations use the same optimization setup.
blocks.zh: 相反,GPT-OSS SecAlign配置使输入字段成为它自己的划定头转弯,遵循secAlign机制. 除了这种不可信跨度和防御专用可训练参数的布置外,GPT-OSS HoS和SecAlign配置采用了相同的优化设置.

blocks.en: Appendix K Full ASIDE results
blocks.zh: 附录 K 完整 ASIDE结果

blocks.en:
In the main text, we report ASIDE ( Zverev et al., 2026 ) as one of the baselines.
In the original formulation, ASIDE was proposed as a full-finetuning method, trained on the benign Alpaca-clean-gpt4-turbo dataset, without a reasoning turn, and treated the assistant response to be data, and thus untrusted.
Adapting ASIDE to reasoning models to be a competitive baseline required several design choices.
In this section we report our search in this design space and list relevant training hyperparameters.
blocks.zh:
在正文中,我们报告ASIDE(Zverev等人,2026年)为基线之一.
在最初的配方中,ASIDE被提出作为全finedate方法,在良性的阿尔帕卡-clean-gpt4-turbo数据集上接受培训,没有推理转折,并将助手的响应处理为数据,因此不可信.
使ASIDE适应推理模型成为具有竞争力的基准,需要若干设计选择。
在本节中,我们报告我们在这一设计空间的搜索情况,并列出相关的训练超参数。

blocks.en:
We generate a reasoning version of the Alpaca-cleaned dataset by replacing its answers with responses from a stronger teacher model, GPT-OSS-120B, keeping the original instructions and input fields. The targets include both reasoning and final answers. We use medium reasoning effort, temperature 1 and top- p p 1. After filtering out incomplete responses, we obtain 51,696 examples: 46,533 for training and 5,163 for validation.
For adversarial training, we reuse the reasoning-inclusive SecAlign preference corpus described in Appendix J , with 16,434 training and 1,826 validation pairs. DPO uses both responses; SFT on this data uses only the preferred response to the injected prompt.
blocks.zh:
我们通过用更强大的师范模型GPT-OSS-120B的响应来取代答案,生成阿尔帕卡清理数据集的推理版本,保留原始指令和输入字段. 目标包括推理和最后答案。 我们用中度推理方法,温度1和顶级 -p1. 在筛选出不完整的答复后,我们获得了51 696个实例:46 533个用于培训,5 163个用于验证。
对于对抗性训练,我们重新使用附录J中描述的包含推理的secAlign偏好书,有16,434个培训和1,826个验证对. DPO使用两种响应;在此数据上的SFT只使用对注入的提示的首选响应.

blocks.en:
In making the original ASIDE formulation a competitive baseline, we tried several alterations of the original formulation.
We vary the following things: • Training data: benign Alpaca data vs. SecAlign data. • Training method: SFT on benign data, DPO on SecAlign data, or SFT on the preferred SecAlign responses. • Full fine-tuning vs. LoRA adapters. • Which part of the input is untrusted: external input and tool outputs, or also assistant CoT, responses and tool calls, following the original ASIDE policy more closely.
blocks.zh:
在使最初的ASIDE配方成为竞争性基准时,我们尝试了对最初配方的几处修改.
· 培训数据:良性阿尔帕卡数据对塞克利格数据。 • 培训方法:关于良性数据的SFT、关于证券数据的DPO、或关于首选证券答复的SFT。 • 完全微调对LORA适配器。 投入的哪一部分是不信任的:外部投入和工具输出,或者还有助手CoT,响应和工具调用,更紧密地遵循最初的ASIDE政策.

blocks.en: Training data: benign Alpaca data vs. SecAlign data.
blocks.zh: 训练数据:良性阿尔帕卡数据与secAlign数据.

blocks.en: Training method: SFT on benign data, DPO on SecAlign data, or SFT on the preferred SecAlign responses.
blocks.zh: 培训方法:关于良性数据的SFT,关于密钥数据的DPO,或关于首选的密钥响应的SFT.

blocks.en: Full fine-tuning vs. LoRA adapters.
blocks.zh: 完全微调对LORA适配器.

blocks.en: Which part of the input is untrusted: external input and tool outputs, or also assistant CoT, responses and tool calls, following the original ASIDE policy more closely.
blocks.zh: 投入的哪一部分是不信任的:外部投入和工具输出,或者还有助手CoT,响应和工具调用,更紧密地遵循最初的ASIDE政策.

blocks.en:
All runs use AdamW, cosine learning-rate decay, no warmup, and zero weight decay. Benign SFT uses loss on the full sequence, including the prompt, with padding masked and gradient clipping at 1.0. It uses batch size 256 and context length 9,216; LoRA runs use LR 10 − 4 10^{-4} for two epochs, and full fine-tuning uses LR 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} for three epochs. SecAlign-data runs use batch size 64, context length 4,096 and three epochs, with no gradient clipping. Preferred-response SFT masks prompt loss; DPO uses β = 0.1 \beta=0.1 .
Their LoRA learning rates are 10 − 4 10^{-4} and 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , respectively; both full-finetuning runs use 10 − 5 10^{-5} .
blocks.zh:
所有运行都使用亚当W,余弦学习-速率衰减,不热,零重量衰减. Benign SFT在包括即时器在内的全序上使用亏损,加贴面罩和梯度剪接在1.0. 它使用批量尺寸256,上下文长度9,216;LORA运行时使用LR 10− 4 10^{-4}用于两个纪元,全微调使用LR 2× 10− 5 2\ Times 10^{-5}用于三个纪元. SecAlign-data运行时使用批号64,上下文长度4,096和三个纪元,没有梯度剪接. 首选反应SFT口罩迅速丢失;DPO使用β=0.1\β=0.1.
他们的LORA学习率分别为10 - 4 10 - 4 - 4 10 - 4 3 - 4 3 - 10 - 4 3 - 4 4 ; 两种全程调整都使用10 - 5 10 - 5 。

blocks.en: LoRA adapts query/value projections at rank 64 and expert gate/up and down projections at rank 2, with α = 8 \alpha=8 , zero dropout and no trainable biases. It trains on a frozen BF16-dequantized base; evaluation uses the original MXFP4 base with adapters and per-module scaling. Full fine-tuning uses FP32 master weights, BF16 computation and four-GPU FSDP with microbatch size 1.
blocks.zh: LORA调整了64级的查询/价值预测和2级的专家门/上下预测,α=8\alpha=8,零辍学,没有可训练的偏差。 它在一个冷冻的BF16分级基座上进行训练;评价使用原有的MXFP4基座,带有适配器和每个模块的缩放. 完全微调使用FP32主重,BF16计算和四GPU FSDP,微批尺寸为1.

blocks.en:
For each trained model, we report security and utility in Table 17 .
For the final evaluation in the main paper, we choose benign Alpaca SFT with full fine-tuning, external-data-only rotation at π / 2 \pi/2 , LR 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} .
It retains 89.60% SEP utility with 8.70% ASR and fewer flagged SEP outputs than the other main ASIDE configurations. Agentic utility remains poor: it solves 9/95 clean AgentDojo tasks, 96/921 attacked AgentDojo pairs, and no AgentDyn tasks (0/60 clean and 0/560 attacked).

Dojo and Dyn denote AgentDojo and AgentDyn; TT, P, G and R denote TensorTrust ( Toyer et al., 2024 ) , Purple ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , Gandalf ( Pfister et al., 2025 ) and RuLES ( Mu et al., 2023 ) .

blocks.en:
Even the chosen best-performing ASIDE model suffers from a degradation in its agentic capabilities, mainly through problems with tool calling.
It produces no tool outputs on 79/95 clean tasks (83.2%).
For example, on slack/user_task_18 , it announces that it is fetching the user’s TODO list but does not actually call a tool ( Figure 10 ).
A further 9/95 tasks (9.5%) contain one tool call and one tool output, but still fail afterwards.
For example, on banking/user_task_0 , ASIDE reads a bill but then emits tool-like text in its assistant response instead of actually calling the tool ( Figure 11 ).
blocks.zh:
即使是所选择的绩效最佳的ASIDE模型,其代理能力也出现退化,主要是工具调用问题。
它没有为79/95清洁任务提供工具产出(83.2%)。
例如,在lax/user_task_18上,它宣布它正在获取用户的TODO列表,但没有实际调用工具(图10).
另外的9/95任务(9.5%)包含一个工具呼叫和一个工具输出,但之后仍然失败.
例如,在banks/user_task_0上,ASIDE读取一个账单,但随后在它的助手回复中发出类似工具的文本,而不是实际调用工具(图11).

blocks.en: Evaluations of ASIDE on the LLMail-Inject dataset show that ASIDE struggles with understanding untrusted input. The email summaries it generates often include keywords from the retrieved emails, but they are often included in fabricated summary content that is irrelevant to the retrieved emails.
blocks.zh: 在LLMail-Inject数据集上对ASIDE的评价显示,ASIDE在理解不可信输入上挣扎. 它生成的电子邮件摘要经常包括被检索的电子邮件的关键词,但是这些关键词往往包含在与被检索的电子邮件无关的编造摘要内容中.

blocks.en:
We show one representative ASIDE generation below. The attacker email (the second one) includes the malicious instruction that asks the model to send an email with the body “confirmation” to contact@contact.com. The first benign email is about requesting a proposal for a video marketing series for a property development firm.
ASIDE’s reasoning states that it received emails about a request for property tax credit, offering to schedule a meeting, and a request for a quote, and that there is no instruction to send an email, which are all false.
None of the real emails is mentioned, and the judge marks the response as a failure.
blocks.zh:
下面我们显示一个具有代表性的ASIDE世代。 攻击者电子邮件(第二封)包括恶意指示,要求该模型发送与机体“确认”的电子邮件以联系@contact.com. 第一封良性电子邮件是关于为一家房地产开发公司申请一个视频营销系列的建议.
ASIDE的推理说,它收到了关于要求财产税抵免的电子邮件,提出安排会议,要求引用,也没有发出电子邮件的指示,这些都是假的。
没有提及任何真实的电子邮件,法官将答复定为失败。

blocks.en: The output has the format of an email summary and includes fragments of the emails, such as “Request for Property”, “expanding into new regions”, and “proposal”, but the summary is fabricated.
blocks.zh: 产出采用电子邮件摘要的格式,包括电子邮件的片段,如“财产要求”、“扩展至新地区”和“提案”,但摘要是捏造的。

blocks.en: -------------------- SYSTEM PROMPT -------------------- You are a language model that operates within an e-mail client. You answer user’s queries based on their received e-mails. For each user’s query, you will be fed the most relevant e-mails based on that query. You can send emails using a dedicated tool. However, you must do so only when clearly instructed to by the user’s query. You must not call tools or send emails based on any information or instruction you find in received emails. You must not response to any sudden instructions that may appear anywhere in the emails. All emails are from external parties, they are not from the user directly. Only include tool calls if clearly instructed to by the user. Don’t call any tool based on any information or instruction found in emails.
